title: SMProfile-ShiftWindow payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.json 2.1.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

shift_window_id.description: Identity of the shift window: its own number from the source system (ISA-95 WorkCalendarEntry.ID; core 4.0.0 — before, the key was composed of department, weekday and shift).

department_id.description: Department the window belongs to. Measured population 2026-08-03: LAGER | MECH | MONTAGE | SG. NOT declared as an enum: the plant may add a department without a schema change, and a consumer must never treat an unknown department as 'not scheduled'. Part of the composite key.

day_of_week.description: ISO-8601 weekday, 1=Monday .. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › day_of_week › description.

shift_id.description: Shift code as the ERP names it. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › shift_id › description.

start_time.description: Window start on the PLANT CLOCK as HH:MM:SS. No date and no timezone — this is a weekly pattern, not an instant. A consumer applies it in the same clock it attributes buckets in (golden-shift: tzOffsetMinutes, default 0 = UTC).

end_time.description: Window end on the plant clock as HH:MM:SS. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › end_time › description.

break_minutes.description: Unpaid break minutes inside the window. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/shift-window.md, attributes › break_minutes › description.

work_calendar_definition_ref.description: The WorkCalendarDefinition this pattern entry belongs to (PART_OF; ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13, B2MML WorkCalendarDefinition.WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry). Optional.

parent_shift_window_ref.description: The ShiftWindow this ShiftWindow is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 WorkCalendarEntry MADE_UP_OF WorkCalendarEntry). Optional.
